::: {.research-intro}
I write these tools for problems that keep coming up in survey work: getting data out of SurveyCTO, handling dates recorded in the Ethiopian calendar, and finding microdata in public catalogs. Three are R packages on CRAN and two are Stata modules on SSC. The R packages are MIT-licensed and the source code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/GutUrago).
:::
